column1: # Pokémon Shield: Game Freak's engine on SDK 7.3.2 (NVN, Wwise, NintendoWare Vfx), update 1.3.2; Pokémon Sword's twin (0100ABF008968000), the same values but its own main build.
# Made from the survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and checked by hand against it and Sword's profile; boots on Android (2026-11-13, AYN Odin 2).
# The rewriter's patches of 1.3.2's main are in patches.py
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB)
